resources.string: Your home has no federation yet, so it can\'t join assistants on other servers.
Your home\'s server has no federation extension to turn on. Update it first.

This device reaches your home at a local address, which other servers can\'t reach. Sign in to your home at its public address, or hold a Wired network at home and use its address: under Settings → Servers, open your home\'s server.
Your home is on Wired, but none of your servers here holds its network. Open your home under Settings → Servers and hold a network there, then try again.
This server is in another Wired network. Turn Wired off on it under Settings → Servers, then try again: it joins your home\'s.
Joining the assistant from home didn\'t work.
This server isn\'t one this device made on exe.dev.
That didn\'t work. A pairing code works once, for ten minutes: ask an admin for a new one. A token works until it is revoked.
